states.source: AsyncLoading from eventDetailViewModelProvider renders _EventDetailLoadingScreen, a content-shaped event-detail skeleton; credible initialEvent fallback data renders EventDetailBody instead.
states.nextAction: Compare the event-detail loading skeleton against Claude references once canonical PNG export exists.

states.source: AsyncData(null) renders CatchErrorScaffold with Event not found copy.
states.nextAction: Decide whether not-found remains a branded error surface or needs a dedicated empty Event Detail state.
Define whether offline-specific copy should diverge from the generic branded event error surface.

states.source: Authenticated member with profile, reviews, deterministic host card, bookable CTA, and default presentation mode.
states.nextAction: Move EventDetailBody visibility decisions into section view-state adapters before visual parity edits.
Compare ticket mode hero and ticket stub against the Claude TicketStub contract.
Compare the dark surface style against the Claude pigment hero and ticket body contract.

states.source: Unauthenticated users see event body with guest booking CTA and locked who-is-going context.
states.nextAction: Compare guest booking dock, locked social proof, and auth redirect copy against Claude references.

states.source: Host role suppresses consumer booking actions and treats hosted clubs as host context.
states.nextAction: Keep host app Event Detail in this read-only detail contract; host management actions belong to the future host event management contract.

states.source: Signed-up participants see the cancel-booking dock and companion/invite entry points; booking and cancel success feedback use the shared Catch snackbar helper.
states.nextAction: Signed-up booking-dock mode derivation now maps through EventDetailBookingDockState; continue visual comparison only if the captured dock diverges from the booking dock reference.

states.source: EventDetailDock listens to EventBookingController mutations and maps pending flags into EventDetailBookingDockState; EventDetailBody routes booking/cancel success feedback through the shared Catch snackbar helper.
states.nextAction: Booking and cancel pending route captures now prove disabled loading dock affordances; continue waitlist-specific pending variants only if product needs separate visual proof.

states.source: Booking/cancel mutation failures are surfaced by the EventDetailBookingDockMutationState and EventDetailDock tests; success feedback uses the shared Catch snackbar helper.
states.nextAction: Booking/cancel failure dock banners and success snackbars now have route capture proof; full booking celebration remains covered by focused widget tests.

states.source: EventDetailBookingDockState derives sold-out, waitlist, cancellation, and past-event action states from Event and EventParticipation before EventDetailDock renders the provider-free dock.
states.nextAction: Split waitlist, offer, full, attended, cancelled, and past states into separate BookingDock adapter states after the adapter exists.

states.source: Current fatal-error path can show backend/network failures, but there is no explicit offline composition state.
states.nextAction: Define explicit offline copy and retry behavior if product wants this to diverge from the generic event error surface.

states.source: Text-scale 2.0 is exercised through the full Event Detail composition on the tall review device.
states.nextAction: Compare tall-device text-scale capture after section adapters reduce layout drift.

states.source: Hero and route transition motion is exercised with animations disabled across the full Event Detail composition.
states.nextAction: Compare reduced-motion capture for hero presentation modes and route transition.

composition.currentLayout: EventDetailScreen reads eventDetailViewModelProvider, owns the loaded Scaffold, mutation listeners, route callbacks, host/companion display-state derivation, and bottom navigation CTA; EventDetailBody owns the CustomScrollView, hero app bar, ticket band, local sections, host/companion/invite cards, and social section.
composition.targetLayout: EventDetailScreen maps provider state into EventDetailScreenState-style adapters and composes registered sections: hero, ticket facts, plan, click hints, itinerary, photo proof, host card, who-is-going, reviews, map, mechanics, good-to-know, companion/invite prompts, and booking dock.

sections.name: Event hero
sections.targetOwner: registered Event Detail hero section with view data and user intents
sections.migration: Register the hero section/component contract, move save/calendar visibility into an adapter view model, keep saved/calendar fallback feedback on the shared Catch snackbar helper, and add Widgetbook states for saved, pending, ticket, and dark variants.

sections.name: Ticket fact band
sections.migration: Convert the component to accept explicit cells, keep the Event adapter responsible for deriving when/where/pace copy, and add Widgetbook coverage.

sections.name: The plan
sections.migration: Split plan copy into a small section adapter so the section renders text roles and lower-level layout only.

sections.name: Why you might click
sections.targetOwner: registered hint-list compound plus event section wrapper
sections.migration: Move event-derived hint copy into adapter data and let HintList accept rows plus activity tone.

sections.name: Itinerary
sections.migration: Convert to explicit step input, then keep event-derived default itinerary generation outside the visual component.

sections.name: Photo proof strip
sections.migration: Accept explicit cells, caption, and data copy so the same strip can serve event, website, and social proof templates.

sections.name: Where
sections.migration: Split visual map card props from event location derivation and declare masking rules for pixel comparison.

sections.name: How sign-ups work
sections.migration: Move mechanism row construction out of the visual list and use explicit row data plus activity tone.

sections.name: Good to know
sections.migration: Implemented through EventDetailInformationState row data and the provider-free EventDetailGoodToKnowList.

sections.name: Your hosts
sections.migration: Club lookup remains route-owned. The Hosted by Section contains a Field with PersonLayout identity, verified status and typed secondary actions.

sections.name: Who's going
sections.migration: Split guest lock copy, avatar stack, and member context into explicit section states.

sections.name: Reviews
sections.migration: Make review access an explicit adapter field and avoid having the section recompute attendance rules.

sections.name: Cross Paths event consent
sections.targetOwner: route-owned consent state plus provider-free Event Detail section
sections.migration: Implemented behind a default-off flag. EventDetailScreen resolves effective local visibility, owns the caller-scoped provider and callable mutation, and passes explicit state/callbacks to the provider-free section.

sections.name: Companion and invite prompts
sections.migration: Event-success plan lookup and companion availability are route-owned and mapped through EventDetailCompanionState; remaining work is formal prompt-section registration and invite-loop state hardening.

sections.name: Booking dock
sections.migration: EventDetailDock now maps provider and mutation output through provider-free EventDetailBookingDockState, then renders the result through EventBookingDock while keeping mutation execution at the route/widget edge.

openGaps.nextAction: `catch.event_detail_sections` is now the canonical screen-contract registry entry for Event Detail hero, ticket facts, overview primitives, host/social sections, Cross Paths event consent, companion prompt, booking dock, and avatar stack; reusable primitives stay in their existing shared contracts.

Widgetbook entries now cover EventDetailHeroTopBar, TicketStub, Overview, HintList, Itinerary, PhotoStrip, MapCard, MechanismList, HostCard, WhoIsGoingSection/social proof, Reviews, Cross Paths event consent, companion/invite prompts, and provider-free EventBookingDock states.

Host lookup, companion plan lookup, Cross Paths consent, booking dock mode, body section visibility, invite-loop visibility, host-app bottom-nav visibility, and social/review access now map through provider-free EventDetailHostState, EventDetailCompanionState, CrossPathsEventConsentSectionState, EventDetailBookingDockState, EventDetailSectionVisibilityState, and EventDetailSocialState.

Route captures now cover guest, host app, offline-looking error, text-scale, reduced-motion, signed-up, booking/cancel pending, booking/cancel success snackbars, booking/cancel failures, waitlist, waitlist offer, full, attended, past, and cancelled Event Detail states.
